pr.title: feat(coldstart): salvage install.sh + update/upgrades → src/dopemux/coldstart/
pr.body:
## Summary
- Extract platform detection (`detect_platform` → `platform.py`), secrets resolution (`resolve_secret_value`, `read_secret_from_keychain`, `read_secret_from_1password` → `secrets_resolver.py`), network management (`ensure_docker_networks` → `network.py`), and compose orchestration (`install_docker_services` pattern → `compose_orchestrator.py`) from install.sh into typed Python modules under src/dopemux/coldstart/.
- Extract `UpdateManager` and `RollbackManager` from src/dopemux/update/ and upgrades/ into `update_manager.py` and `rollback_manager.py` within the coldstart package.
- Zero behavior change — pure extraction + type hints + unit tests with mocked Docker/keychain.

## Scope
Series: DMX-COLDSTART. Risk: MED. Wave: 0 (entry point, no deps). Foundation for CS-102/103/104/111/116.

## Validation
Run packet validation commands and capture proof under `proof/TP-DMX-COLDSTART-SALVAGE-COLDSTART-LIB-101/PROOF.json`.

## NOT_RUN
List any skipped live-Docker, keychain, or integration checks explicitly.

steps.task: Inspect repo truth before editing. Read install.sh functions: detect_platform (line 960), install_with_brew/apt/dnf/pacman (1159/1197/1227/1258), resolve_secret_value (453), resolve_existing_env_value (373), read_secret_from_keychain (396), read_secret_from_1password (404), read_secret_from_command (415), ensure_docker_networks (702), install_docker_services (1391), wait_for_containers (852), check_system_resources (813). Read src/dopemux/update/__init__.py, manager.py (UpdateManager, UpdateConfig, VersionInfo, UpdateResult — classes at lines 38/47/64/73), health.py, phases.py, progress.py, rollback.py (RollbackManager at line 23). Read src/dopemux/upgrades/__init__.py, context.py, runner.py (PipelineRunner at line 12). Read src/dopemux/cli.py around line 725 (init command) and src/dopemux/commands/mcp_commands.py (mcp_init_cmd at line 576, force/envrc logic at 611-622) to understand what coldstart.py must NOT duplicate yet. Verify src/dopemux/coldstart/ does not yet exist. Check tests/coldstart/ (may not exist either). Check tests/scripts/test_install_sh_secrets.py and tests/scripts/test_shell_installer.py to understand what bash-layer tests already exist and must not be broken.
validation: Canonical writers for platform detection (install.sh bash), secrets resolution (install.sh + mcp_commands.py), and update/rollback (src/dopemux/update/) are identified and their consumers enumerated.

Existing bash-layer tests in tests/scripts/ noted; they must continue to pass after this extraction.
Any missing authority (e.g., Docker SDK vs subprocess approach) recorded as UNKNOWN rather than inferred.

steps.task: Create src/dopemux/coldstart/ package with five extraction modules. (a) platform.py: type-hinted PlatformInfo dataclass (os_family: 'macos'|'linux'|'unknown', arch: str, python_path: str, has_brew: bool, has_apt: bool, has_dnf: bool, has_pacman: bool) and detect_platform() -> PlatformInfo function extracted from install.sh detect_platform (line 960). (b) secrets_resolver.py: SecretSource enum (MANUAL, KEYCHAIN, ONEPASSWORD, COMMAND, ENV, DEFER), SecretResolution dataclass (value: str | None, source: SecretSource, is_sensitive: bool), resolve_secret_value(var: str, current: str | None, env_file: Path | None, non_interactive: bool = False) -> SecretResolution extracted from install.sh resolve_secret_value (453), read_secret_from_keychain (396), read_secret_from_1password (404); uses subprocess for OS calls; non_interactive mode reads from environment or raises. (c) network.py: ensure_docker_networks(networks: list[str]) -> None extracted from install.sh ensure_docker_networks (702); uses subprocess docker network ls/create. (d) compose_orchestrator.py: ComposeOrchestrator class with pull_images(compose_file: Path, profile: str | None) -> None, bring_up(compose_file: Path, profile: str | None, env: dict) -> None, bring_down(compose_file: Path) -> None, wait_healthy(services: list[str], timeout_s: int = 120) -> bool methods extracted from install.sh install_docker_services (1391) and wait_for_containers (852); uses subprocess docker compose. (e) update_manager.py and rollback_manager.py: thin re-exports wrapping src/dopemux/update/manager.UpdateManager and src/dopemux/update/rollback.RollbackManager under the coldstart namespace for downstream packets (CS-118) to import from one place. src/dopemux/coldstart/__init__.py: exports all public symbols.
requirements: Zero behavior change: extracted Python functions must produce the same decisions as the bash originals for the same inputs.
Type hints on all public functions and dataclasses; Pydantic or dataclasses acceptable.
No business logic newly added beyond what install.sh or update/ already implement.
All subprocess calls use safe_subprocess patterns or subprocess.run with explicit argument lists (no shell=True with user-controlled strings).
No hardcoded secrets, dev defaults, or placeholder values in any module.
Docker and keychain calls are injectable (accept a runner callable or subprocess.run by default) to enable mocking in tests.
validation: python -c 'from dopemux.coldstart import platform, secrets_resolver, network, compose_orchestrator' runs without ImportError.
No baked secret defaults (CHANGE_ME, dev_password, sk-dev) appear in src/dopemux/coldstart/.

steps.task: Write unit tests. (a) tests/coldstart/__init__.py: create (empty, marks package). (b) tests/coldstart/test_platform.py: test detect_platform() returns PlatformInfo with correct os_family on the CI runner OS; mock shutil.which to control brew/apt detection. (c) tests/coldstart/test_secrets_resolver.py: test resolve_secret_value with non_interactive=True reads from monkeypatched env; test missing required secret in non_interactive raises; test keychain path (mock subprocess returning test value); test DEFER path returns SecretResolution with value=None. (d) tests/coldstart/test_network.py: mock subprocess.run; assert ensure_docker_networks calls 'docker network create' for a network not in mock ls output; assert idempotent when network already exists. (e) tests/coldstart/test_compose_orchestrator.py: mock subprocess.run; assert ComposeOrchestrator.bring_up calls 'docker compose up -d'; assert wait_healthy returns False on timeout when mock containers stay unhealthy. (f) tests/coldstart/test_update_manager.py: import UpdateManager from dopemux.coldstart.update_manager; assert it is the same class as src/dopemux/update/manager.UpdateManager (identity or isinstance check). (g) proof/TP-DMX-COLDSTART-SALVAGE-COLDSTART-LIB-101/PROOF.json: commands, exit codes, diff scope, residual risks, UNKNOWNs.
